title: Surf Session Finder
description: Surf park sessions schedule availability and notifications for wave park surfers worldwide
summary: Surf park sessions schedule availability and notifications for wave park surfers worldwide
offersHint: Surf park sessions schedule availability and notifications for wave park surfers worldwide · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://ssf-api-cf.surfsessionfinder.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_pools
toolsPreview.description: List all supported surf pools worldwide with their IDs, names, and locations. Always call this first to get valid pool_id values for the other tools.

toolsPreview.name: get_session_levels
toolsPreview.description: Get the available session difficulty levels for a surf pool (e.g. Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced). Use the level names with find_sessions.

toolsPreview.name: find_sessions
toolsPreview.description: Find available surf sessions at a pool. Returns date, time, skill level, available spots, and a booking URL. Filter by level, minimum spots, or time window.
